title: Digimon Worlds Re:Compiled mod index entry (meta.json)
description: Checked by tools/build-index (the source of truth); this schema is for editors. A listing that points at the mod's own repository needs id, title, author, version, categories, games, repo and github (or downloadURL). For a mod hosted in the index (a mod/ folder beside meta.json) meta.json is optional and every field comes from its mod.toml, so nothing is required here.

id.description: The mod's id, exactly as in its mod.toml.

version.description: Version of the release this entry describes (1.2.0). With github set, the newest release is filled in automatically.

summary.description: One sentence shown on the mod's card.

repo.description: Where the source and issue tracker live.

github.description: owner/repo whose Releases carry <id>-<version>.zip. Turns on automatic version tracking.

downloadURL.description: A direct link to an installable .zip; required when there is no github.

engine.description: Re:Compiled versions the mod works with, as a semver range (">=0.2").

fixed_release_tag.description: List this release tag instead of the newest one.
